meeting.name: Punchestown
meeting.going: Good to yielding-yielding in places on hurdle & chase course

races.title: Donohue Marquees Risk Of Thunder Chase
races.verdict: STUMPTOWN is a very smart performer in cross-country events, winning 5 times including this race, at the Cheltenham Festival and the historic Velka Pardubicka, and he looks to hold strong claims after reappearing with a victory over hurdles. The biggest threat could come from Fountain House , while The Goffer is also considered. STUMPTOWN (IRE) FOUNTAIN HOUSE (IRE) THE GOFFER (IRE)

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: THEFLYINGKING may have his quirks but sets the standard and should be well up to winning a race of this nature. Bumper winner Sparkling Wit is bred to be at least smart over jumps and entitled to be in the mix, with Border Lad , Ravendark and Sine Qua Non others to consider. THEFLYINGKING (IRE) SPARKLING WIT (IRE) BORDER LAD (IRE)

races.title: Pertemps Network Group Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)
races.verdict: A very competitive renewal and it could be worth taking a chance on HGRANCA DE THAIX , who looks well treated on the pick of last season's form. Buachaillbocht is capable fresh and heads the dangers along with J'Arrive de L'Est , who could still have more to offer for the Emmet Mullins yard. HGRANCA DE THAIX (FR) BUACHAILLBOCHT J'ARRIVE DE L'EST (FR)

races.title: Colm Quinn BMW Novice Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: A cleaner round of jumping can see unexposed GOMEZ ADDAMS make it 2 wins from 3 starts over hurdles. Crystabel may be the main danger if allowed to dictate, while there could be more to come from Bunker Buster if putting it all together. GOMEZ ADDAMS (IRE) CRYSTABEL (IRE) BUNKER BUSTER (IRE)

races.title: Frontline Security Grabel Mares Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict: A listed mares hurdle in which OLDSCHOOL OUTLAW looks the most solid option on the pick of her form last season. Savante heads the list of dangers from Alliteration . OLDSCHOOL OUTLAW (IRE) SAVANTE (IRE) ALLITERATION (IRE)

races.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Craddockstown Novice Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict: LOVELY HURLING has made a promising start over fences, closing all the way to the line when runner-up in a Grade 3 novice at Navan in February, and he could be ready to go one better on his return. Stablemate Zanoosh appeals as a noteworthy recruit to chasing and is feared most, ahead of Kainsbourg . LOVELY HURLING (IRE) ZANOOSH (IRE) KAINSBOURG (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Zanoosh (2/1), Lovely Hurling (9/4), Ocastle Des Mottes (3/1), Frankie John (11/2), Kainsbourg (10/1), Soir De Garde (66/1)

races.title: John Durkan Memorial Punchestown Chase (Grade 1)
races.verdict: Willie Mullins has dominated this race in recent times and GAELIC WARRIOR is taken to land the prize for the second year in succession. After impressive wins at both Cheltenham and this course in the spring, he can pick up where he left off to confirm the placings with Fact To File from last year's renewal, with Final Demand completing the shortlist. GAELIC WARRIOR (GER) FACT TO FILE (FR) FINAL DEMAND (IRE)

races.title: Keadeen Hotel (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: CEASAR'S BALL looks another interesting type for powerful connections, and he's taken to follow up his point win on Rules debut. Water Mill is an intriguing danger switched to a bumper, with Night Chaperone the pick of those with experience. Martin Brassil's newcomer Doyouhearmenow completes the shortlist. CEASAR'S BALL (FR) WATER MILL (IRE) NIGHT CHAPERONE (IRE)
